scope: Read-only recommendation model. Does not authorize crafting, extraction, enhancement or fodder use.
limit_note: Luna III change from one to two. Remaining quota and definition availability must be provided or read separately; this advisor did not inspect them.

guarantee.transition: If remaining_upgrade_events <= required_hits - hits_so_far, select uniformly among the two defined stats; otherwise uniformly among all four.
guarantee.evidence: Original community empirical report, 2025-03-26; total-hit guarantee, not two upgrades to each selected stat.

creation_four_line_probability.status: Community model assumption, not confirmed official probability disclosure
creation_four_line_probability.verification_note: 2026-09-29: user confirmed 1/3; formula regression distinguishes 2/3 three-line + 1/3 four-line definition mixture from domain 1/5 four-line drops. 0.34 retained only as a historical sensitivity comparison.

remaining_stat_generation.method: Weighted sequential sampling without replacement, excluding main and both defined substats
remaining_stat_generation.status: Community artifact generation model applied to undefined slots; not official server implementation verification

roll_tiers: Reuse five-star-substat-tiers.json and enhancer/model.py; four equal-probability raw tiers per roll.

domain_four_line_probability.note: Domain drops only; never used for artifact definition.
